name: @pcc/demo-video
description: PCC hackathon demo video built with Remotion

scripts.render:draft: npx remotion render src/index.ts PCCDemo-Full --codec h264 --crf 28 --scale 0.5 --x264-preset ultrafast
scripts.render:final: npx remotion render src/index.ts PCCDemo-Full --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:thumbnail: npx remotion still src/index.ts Thumbnail --frame 80 --image-format png
